query: SELECT c.layout_override_json::text AS override_json, l.layout_json::text AS streamer_layout_json, l.cam_enabled AS "cam_enabled?", l.mode AS "mode?" FROM twitch_clips_social_media c LEFT JOIN social_media_streamer_layout l ON LOWER(l.streamer_login) = LOWER(c.streamer_login) WHERE c.id = $1 LIMIT 1
